installed_observation.scope: Version only; no tool invocation or organic measurement.

facts: FunctionCall has required call_id, optional response-item id and namespace, and arguments as a JSON string.
CustomToolCall has required call_id/name/input and optional id/namespace.
FunctionCallOutput has optional call_id/id/name/namespace; its wire output supports text or structured content.
LocalShellCall preserves legacy id and optional call_id; missing both cannot establish identity.
ToolSearchCall has optional id/call_id and its own native variant; unsupported normalization remains unknown rather than zero.
ItemCompleted binds thread_id,turn_id,item and optional timing.
TurnStarted binds turn_id and optional root turn; turn context can retain optional turn/root IDs.
MCP begin/end expose call_id and defaulted turn strings; an empty turn is unresolved.
Native tagged TurnItem includes command,MCP,dynamic,collaboration,web,image,extension andfile-change variants.
Known non-call messages/plans/reasoning/compaction may be ignored; unsupported invocation variants must remain unknown rather than disappear into a zero.
ResponseItemEnvelope keeps the native item and separate optional harness metadata.
RolloutLine contains timestamp, optional ordinal and a flattened item.
Optional retained-source metadata can support context provenance; it is not user authorization and is never assumed present or complete.
Snake-case tagged wire items keep payload for session_meta,response_item,turn_context,event_msg.
Response-item metadata is separate and optional; the payload remains the actual ResponseItem.
The native writer emits UTC timestamps, optional ordinals and flattened serialized items followed by a newline.

limitations: Primary source review, not execution, parser acceptance or native organic observation.
No original client transcript, state database, native IDs, credentials or active configuration read.
